gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the current UI modifications applied to my Jira project so that I can ensure consistency across our team's workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all UI modifications currently applied, including their IDs, types, and statuses.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to create a new UI modification for our project to enhance user experience based on feedback from the team.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the details of the new UI modification and return the created modification's ID and confirmation of success.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete an outdated UI modification that is no longer relevant to our current project setup.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified UI modification and return a success message.

gold.user: As a UX designer, I want to update an existing UI modification to reflect the latest design changes based on user testing results.
